title: Manage Custom Traits
opinionVsTargetedHelp: Trait targeted modifiers change country stats for a named target. Diplomatic opinion modifiers are separate reusable relationship definitions.
targetedModifierHelp: Apply a separate set of country-stat modifiers to each target tag. This is trait targeted_modifier, not diplomatic opinion.
targetedModifierDuplicateKey: Modifier key "{key}" is duplicated for this target. Use a unique key before saving.
opinionSubtitle: Define reusable diplomatic relationship changes for add_opinion_modifier. These are standalone common/opinion_modifiers definitions, not trait targeted modifiers.
opinionDurationHelp: Leave duration fields empty for the game default. Use only the duration units required by your definition.
opinionPreservedFields: This imported definition also has {count} preserved advanced field(s). Saving keeps them unchanged.
opinionPreservedKnownScalar: Imported script value "{value}" is read-only here and will be preserved when you save other fields.
emptyTraits: No custom traits yet. Select New Trait to create one.
nameHint: The trait name on the character card. Fill in at least one language — a language you leave empty falls back to the one you filled. Leave both empty and a new trait shows its raw trait id; a trait that reuses a vanilla id keeps the vanilla name.
scientistConstraintOutro: Standard tech / research modifiers won't apply.
previewNoModifiers: No modifiers yet. Add a JSON object above to see the effects here.
skillFactorsSection: Skill factors (decimal · 0.0 = no bonus · multiplied vs base skill)
modifierVariantsSection: Modifier variants (JSON object — applies in specific contexts)
scriptBlocksSection: Script blocks (raw HOI4 trigger / effect script · emitted as)
canvasEmpty: No traits in the trait tree yet. The tree only shows traits with gui_row ≥ 0. Set gui_row to an integer starting at 0 under Advanced fields → Tree position, and the trait appears here.
canvasHint: Drag a node to change gui_row / gui_column. Drag from a node's bottom handle to another trait's top handle to add an any_parent prerequisite. Select a line and press Delete to remove it.
canvasReadOnlyEdge: Dashed lines are the read-only prerequisite forms (parent block / all_parents). The canvas preserves them verbatim and never rewrites them.
nodeRowColTitle: gui_row · gui_column (row and column in the trait tree)
nodeAutoColumnTitle: gui_column is unset — the game picks a column from trait_type. Dragging horizontally writes an explicit gui_column.
nodeExternalParentsTitle: Prerequisite traits outside this canvas (vanilla traits, or traits not in the tree): {list}
nodeAdvancedParentsTitle: This trait carries a parent block or an all_parents block. The canvas shows it read-only and preserves it verbatim; edit it via raw files.
